areas.name: PSP Route, Import, and Save Safety
areas.location_cue: The PSP title screen, import prompt, difficulty menu, save list, and PPSSPP memory-card folder.
areas.note: The PSP fan-translated build is primary; the official PlayStation localization remains a secondary comparison.

save_backup.why: Import and route flags are easiest to prove from untouched starting data.
save_backup.detail: Keep the pre-import card and the accepted-import card.

levels.1: The portable edition contains the broadest finite route.
levels.2: Play the PSP build through PPSSPP on PC.
levels.3: Use a clean Japanese PSP image with the reviewed English patch, record its patch revision, and preserve the entire PPSSPP save directory before updating either component. Display scaling is fine; gameplay cheats are outside this completion record.

levels.1: The officially localized release uses an earlier content boundary.

items.label: Import the Innocent Sin PSP Save

levels.1: A completed companion save carries several finite records forward.
levels.2: Place the completed Innocent Sin PSP data on the same emulated memory card before starting.
levels.3: Archive the memory card, begin a fresh Eternal Punishment file, accept the import prompt, and verify the carried character statistics, Karma Ring, shared Fusion Spells, Fool and Free cards, donation total, and dialogue flags. Keep a non-import start only as comparison evidence.

levels.1: One protected file should retain the full combat setting.
levels.2: Start the primary branch on the highest built-in difficulty and clear it without reducing the setting.
levels.3: Record the difficulty screen at the beginning, retain the setting through both route clears using separate branches, and preserve the resulting clear data. This documents the available challenge, not an external award.

levels.1: Rumors, partner routes, timed floors, mutations, and post-game imports all branch.
levels.2: Keep external backups before the fifth-member rumor, each random rumor, Mt. Iwato, the ending clear, and EX Dungeon entry.
